title: The Convergence Rate of Stochastic Tracking with Application to Optimal Execution
abstract: arXiv:2608.29468v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the quadratic tracking problem of a general stochastic target process with absolutely continuous controls, with and without terminal constraint. We derive explicit, non-asymptotic upper bounds in terms of a Besov-type modulus of the target. These bounds yield sharp explicit rates that specialize to the square-root order for semimartingale targets. We then apply these results to a generalized Obizhaeva--Wang execution model with random terminal inventory. We first develop a Hilbert-space approach to characterize its optimal strategy, which includes jumps. To avoid such trading spikes, one regularizes the problem by a quadratic trading-rate penalty with coefficient $\varepsilon$. We then show that the regularized optimal execution cost---and therefore the excess price impact cost of the regularized optimal strategy---converges at the sharp rate $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$. translated_title: 随机追踪的收敛率及其在最优执行中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在绝对连续控制下对一般随机目标过程的二次追踪问题，涵盖带终端约束与不带终端约束两种情形。我们利用目标的Besov型模量推导出显式的非渐近上界，这些界给出了精确的显式收敛率，对于半鞅目标可特化为平方根阶。随后我们将这些结果应用于具有随机终端库存的广义Obizhaeva–Wang执行模型。我们首先发展了一种希尔伯特空间方法来刻画其最优策略，该策略包含跳跃。为避免此类交易尖峰，可通过引入系数为ε的二次交易速率惩罚项对问题进行正则化。我们进而证明，正则化后的最优执行成本——即正则化最优策略的超额价格冲击成本——以精确的O(√ε)速率收敛。由于正则化最优策略无法以闭式形式获得（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对随机目标的二次追踪问题，利用Besov型模量推导出显式非渐近收敛率上界，并将其应用于带随机终端库存的广义Obizhaeva–Wang最优执行模型，证明经二次交易速率惩罚正则化后的最优执行成本以精确的O(√ε)速率收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper derives explicit non-asymptotic upper bounds on the convergence rate of quadratic stochastic tracking in terms of a Besov-type modulus, and applies them to a generalized Obizhaeva–Wang optimal execution model with random terminal inventory, showing that the regularized optimal execution cost converges at the sharp rate O(√ε).
